jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Metrics Recruitment
is partnering with a global digital asset group building a regulated fund management business in the UAE. The licence is in place and the first fund is a digital asset fund-of-funds allocating to external managers, with more strategies planned after launch.

We are hiring a Senior Portfolio Manager
to run the fund and act as the regulator-facing approved person for the licensed entity. This is a hands-on build seat, where you will be the first hire on the ground in Abu Dhabi and hold a director seat on the regulated entity. The group’s investment team supports the thesis and manager sourcing. Fund operations and portfolio risk sit with you.

Responsibilities

Run fund operations end to end: investor onboarding over fiat and stablecoin rails, subscriptions and redemptions, NAV inputs to the administrator.
Reconcile on-chain and off-chain positions daily.
Own allocation and risk across external managers.
Sit as a director of the licensed entity and act as the approved person with the regulator.
Work directly with Compliance, MLRO, Risk, Finance, and the auditor.
Report risk and performance to the Investment Committee and the boards.
Build the local setup in Abu Dhabi as part of a small team.
Report to the Chief Business Officer.

Requirements

8 to 10 years of portfolio management inside a fund: hedge fund, asset manager, fund-of-funds, or bank prop or discretionary PM.
Personal, hands-on fund operations experience: subscriptions and redemptions, investor onboarding, NAV with an administrator, fund setup.
Investment management track record that supports regulatory fit-and-proper approval.
Experience supervising people.
Willing to hold director seats on regulated entities.
Based in Abu Dhabi, or in Dubai and willing to move.

Nice to Have

Digital asset fund experience: crypto quant, DeFi, custody, on-chain NAV.
Allocating to external managers in a fund-of-funds or multi-manager setup.
Prior approved-person status with a UAE regulator (FSRA, VARA, DFSA).
CFA, CAIA, or FRM.

Location:
Abu Dhabi, UAE
Compensation:
Competitive base plus bonus and equity
